title: Identification of 2,3-oxidosqualene cyclase gene in Eleutherococcus senticosus and its regulatory mechanism in saponin synthesis.
authors: Cui, Yaqi; Ma, Jiacheng; Jiao, Mengying; Zhao, Xueying; Ding, Jingwen; Feng, Chenran; Liu, Peng; Long, Yuehong; Xing, Zhaobin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究刺五加OSC基因在皂苷合成中的功能，涉及转录因子调控启动子及分子对接，但核心是代谢通路而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Oleanane-type triterpenoid saponins are the primary medicinal components of Eleutherococcus senticosus. During saponin biosynthesis in E. senticosus, various members of the 2,3-oxidosqualene cyclase (OSC) gene family can direct 2,3-oxidosqualene into triterpene saponin and sterol synthesis pathways. However, the precise molecular mechanism underlying this phenomenon remains unclear. We initially screened for beta-amyrin synthase 1 (bAS1) and cycloartenol synthase 1 (CAS1) among 10 EsOSC genes using genome-wide identification and correlation analysis. Subcellular localization, catalytic experiments, and in vivo transient overexpression demonstrated that EsbAS1 and EsCAS1 catalyze the formation of the triterpene skeleton beta-amyrin and sterol precursor cycloartenol exclusively in the cytoplasm, enhancing and inhibiting the in vivo biosynthesis of oleanane-type saponins, respectively. Results from site-directed mutagenesis and molecular docking indicated that W-WY and Y-WH triplets characterized the active sites of EsbAS1 and EsCAS1, respectively. GUS (beta-glucuronidase) staining and electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA) experiments on the promoter region revealed that various colored light quality, DNA methylation, and five transcription factors (EsNAC047, EsNAC098, EsWRKY40, EsMYB4, and EsERF66) regulated the expression of EsbAS1 and EsCAS1. This study provides preliminary insights into the molecular mechanisms by which EsbAS1 and EsCAS1 regulate saponin synthesis in E. senticosus.
abstract_zh: 齐墩果烷型三萜皂苷是刺五加（Eleutherococcus senticosus）的主要药用成分。在刺五加的皂苷生物合成过程中，2,3-氧化鲨烯环化酶（OSC）基因家族的不同成员可将2,3-氧化鲨烯引导至三萜皂苷和甾醇合成途径。然而，这一现象背后的精确分子机制仍不清楚。我们最初通过全基因组鉴定和相关性分析，在10个EsOSC基因中筛选出β-香树脂醇合酶1（bAS1）和环阿屯醇合酶1（CAS1）。亚细胞定位、催化实验和体内瞬时过表达表明，EsbAS1和EsCAS1仅在细胞质中催化形成三萜骨架β-香树脂醇和甾醇前体环阿屯醇，分别增强和抑制齐墩果烷型皂苷的体内生物合成。定点突变和分子对接结果表明，W-WY和Y-WH三联体分别表征了EsbAS1和EsCAS1的活性位点。对启动子区域的GUS（β-葡萄糖醛酸酶）染色和电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）实验显示，不同颜色的光质、DNA甲基化以及五种转录因子（EsNAC047、EsNAC098、EsWRKY40、EsMYB4和EsERF66）调控了EsbAS1和EsCAS1的表达。本研究为EsbAS1和EsCAS1调控刺五加皂苷合成的分子机制提供了初步见解。
